sloka: हतश्चायं त्वया वृत्रो ब्रह्महत्या च वासवम् ।बाधते सुरशार्दूल मोक्षं तस्या विनिर्दिश ।। ७.८५.१९ ॥
transliteration: hataścāyaṁ tvayā vṛtro brahmahatyā ca vāsavam ।bādhate suraśārdūla mokṣaṁ tasyā vinirdiśa ।। 7.85.19 ॥

translations.english: O best among gods, Vritra has been killed by you, and now the sin of Brahmanicide afflicts Indra; please prescribe a means of liberation for him from this sin.
